title: 第3章 回春诀命格第4章 我只想种个田养养猪而已为何逼我
content_zh:
“师姐，师弟即将下山寻找机缘突破，还望师姐……”
栾凌注视着明语师姐，他的眼里含着浓厚的爱慕之色，白梧山最温柔的师姐，多少弟子的梦中情人。
他，第一眼就喜欢上了这个师姐。
明语神色平淡，没有正眼看他一眼。
“栾凌师弟，山下危险，注意安全。”
栾凌闻言，身躯一震，师姐还是关心他的。
“师姐，师弟这一次下山，乃是要成就灭魂，届时成为师父的核心弟子之一，到那时，师弟希望能够和师姐共修大道，追寻更高的境界。”
说完，栾凌等着，心情十分忐忑。
他想要得到一个确切的答复，这是他的动力，也是他不惜一切晋升灭魂的缘故。
灭魂，乃是师父所定下境界，想要成为师父的正式弟子，白梧山的核心弟子，必须要灭魂。
师父说过，只收九个正式弟子，那才是他的真正弟子，将会得到师父的培养，继承师父的衣钵，到那时，白梧山的山主之位，也将会从九位弟子中选出来，可谓是前途无量。
三千弟子，只为了九个名额。
“栾凌师弟，师姐心有所属，所以。”
栾凌闻言，震惊抬头，他的身躯颤抖了一下，旋即，掌控好自己的表情，露出了一个十分难看的笑容。
这一切的转变，都在低头抬头间完成。
“师姐，师弟真的没机会了吗？”
明语摇摇头。
她背对着栾凌，话语缓缓飘荡。
“莫要执着于师姐我，白云派还有诸多出色的女修，师弟莫要忘了修炼的初衷。”
背影，逐渐消失。

留下了狰狞扭曲的栾凌，他盯着明语师姐离去的背影。
拳头紧握，整个人都变得不稳定。
“砰。”
一脚，践踏地面，整座山峰都轻微抖动了一下。
两个身影迅速出现在他的面前。
“栾师兄，有何吩咐？”
栾凌阴狠盯着他们两个，扫了一眼前方，内心瞬间定下了一个主意。
“我希望我回来之后，再也看不到许师弟。”
两位师弟闻言，犹豫了一下。
接着，两瓶丹药出现在他们面前。
两位师弟脸色一喜，立刻收下了丹药。
“师兄请放心，我们兄弟二人办事，绝对不会有问题。”
栾凌冷冷道：“我不希望看到他继续留在白云派。”
说完，他走了。
两位师弟对视一眼，打开了药瓶嗅了一口，一脸沉迷陶醉。
“师弟，看来我等也有机会冲刺纳魂。”
“嘻嘻嘻，师兄，恭喜恭喜。”
“师弟，许师弟那边？”
“杀了便是。”
“师弟所言甚是。”
content_en:
"Senior sister, junior brother is about to go down the mountain to look for opportunities to break through. I hope senior sister..."
Luan Ling looked at Senior Sister Mingyu, with deep admiration in his eyes. She was the gentlest Senior Sister in Baiwu Mountain and the dream lover of many disciples.
He fell in love with this senior sister at first sight.
Mingyu looked calm and didn't look at him.
"Junior Brother Luan Ling, it is dangerous down the mountain, please pay attention to safety."
Luan Ling's body trembled when he heard this. The senior sister still cared about him.
"Senior Sister, Junior Brother is going down the mountain this time to achieve Soul Destruction and become one of Master's core disciples. By then, Junior Brother hopes to cultivate the Tao with Senior Sister and pursue a higher realm."
After saying that, Luan Ling waited, feeling very uneasy.
He wanted to get a definite answer. This was his motivation, and it was also the reason why he would be promoted to Soul Destroyer at all costs.
Destroying the soul is the realm set by the master. If you want to become the official disciple of the master and the core disciple of Baiwu Mountain, you must destroy the soul.
The master has said that he will only accept nine formal disciples. Those are his true disciples who will be trained by the master and inherit the master's mantle. By then, the position of the mountain master of Baiwu Mountain will also be selected from the nine disciples. It can be said that the future is bright.
Three thousand disciples, just for nine places.
"Junior brother Luan Ling, senior sister has something in her heart, so."
When Luan Ling heard this, he raised his head in shock. His body trembled, and then he controlled his expression and showed a very ugly smile.
All these changes were completed in the blink of an eye.
"Senior sister, does junior brother really have no chance?"
Mingyu shook his head.
She turned her back to Luan Ling and her words floated slowly.
"Don't be obsessed with me, senior sister. There are many outstanding female cultivators in the Baiyun Sect. Junior brother, don't forget the original intention of cultivation."
The back gradually disappears.
A ferocious and twisted Luan Ling was left behind, staring at the retreating figure of Senior Sister Mingyu.
His fists were clenched and his whole body became unstable.
"Bang."
One kick trampled the ground, and the entire mountain peak shook slightly.
Two figures quickly appeared in front of him.
"Senior Brother Luan, what are your orders?"
Luan Ling stared at the two of them fiercely, glanced ahead, and instantly made up his mind.
"I hope that when I come back, I will never see Junior Brother Xu again."
When the two junior brothers heard this, they hesitated.
Then, two bottles of elixir appeared in front of them.
The two junior brothers looked happy and immediately accepted the elixir.
"Senior brother, please rest assured, there will definitely be no problems for us two brothers to handle things."
Luan Ling said coldly: "I don't want to see him continue to stay in the Baiyun Sect."
After that, he left.
The two junior brothers looked at each other, opened the medicine bottle and took a sip, looking intoxicated.
"Junior brother, it seems that we also have a chance to sprint to collect the soul."
"Hehehe, senior brother, congratulations."
"Junior brother, where is Junior Brother Xu?"
"Just kill him."
"What my junior brother said is true."
